augmentation_policy: Append four context variants to each train row only; unchanged condition body, label, language, category and group. Preserve every source CSV byte as prefix and retain frozen validation/test manifest entries.

source_provenance.partition_policy: Preserve both old source partitions; new scenarios/variants only enter train. Original files and labels are unchanged.
source_provenance.review_policy: Historical road approval fields are not independent validation; derived copies are explicitly drafts.
source_provenance.limitations: Scene and language variants are correlated; not independent clinical observations or real-report validation.
